_comment: Hand-edit this weekly. See app/overrides.py for how it's applied.

games.context: Super Bowl LX rematch. NE traded for A.J. Brown + Romeo Doubs and rebuilt the interior O-line; SEA lost RB Kenneth Walker III (SB MVP) and OC Klint Kubiak. Those roughly cancel out.

bet.note: Market has SEA at 62% fair odds; this model has it at 50/50 after adjustment. Value is on the underdog getting points.

games.context: Rams traded for Myles Garrett + Trent McDuffie and got Aaron Donald out of retirement. SF travels with Kittle, Bosa, and Mike Evans all working back from injury, plus a rotational DL already ruled out.
Joe Burrow missed 9 games in 2025 to a toe injury requiring surgery -- trailing stats include a large Burrow-less stretch. Bengals also traded for DT Dexter Lawrence and overhauled the defense.

bet.note: Healthy Burrow argues for a bigger gap than the raw model shows.

games.context: Both starting QBs missed major 2025 time to injury -- Lamar Jackson (multiple games) and Daniel Jones (season-ending Achilles). Baltimore also fired John Harbaugh for Jesse Minter.

bet.note: Healthy Jackson makes Baltimore a different team than its 2025 numbers show.

games.context: Cleveland traded away Myles Garrett, their best defensive player, to the Rams -- makes an already-bad team on the numbers worse, not better.

bet.note: Model was already very confident; losing Garrett widens the real gap further.

games.context: Arizona cut Kyler Murray for the season (foot injury) and fired the offensive staff -- Jacoby Brissett starts under a brand-new HC. Trailing stats still include Murray's healthy play.

bet.note: Market's -10.5 already prices the QB change accurately -- no edge to exploit.

games.context: Both teams have brand-new starting QBs and new head coaches: Tua Tagovailoa signed with Atlanta (Miami now starts Malik Willis); Las Vegas installed Kirk Cousins under new HC Klint Kubiak.

bet.note: Too much roster turnover on both sides to trust either number.

games.context: Minnesota's 2025 stats reflect a broken QB situation -- they've since installed Kyler Murray (cut by Arizona) as starter over J.J. McCarthy.

bet.note: Raw model favors GB heavily purely because MIN's old QB situation was so bad.

games.context: Jayden Daniels missed 10 games in 2025 (knee/hamstring/elbow) and was shut down in December -- Washington's 5-12 trailing record reflects a team without its franchise QB for most of the year.

bet.note: Model's 84% for Philly is largely an artifact of Daniels' missed time.

games.context: Patrick Mahomes tore his ACL/LCL in December 2025 and missed the rest of the season -- KC's trailing stats include a backup-QB stretch. Bo Nix is also returning from offseason ankle surgery.

bet.note: With Mahomes healthy, KC is better than the raw model's 40% suggests.
